Improved capacities for physical security and stockpile management (PSSM) through infrastructure security upgrades, surplus reduction and training. Support for enhanced security of SALW storages and evidence rooms through infrastructure upgrades has continued during the reporting period. In Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia and Moldova. Diminishing risks of proliferation through reduction of confiscated and surplus stocks of SALW and ammunition, SEESAC supported SALW disposal activities in three (3) jurisdictions: Moldova, Montenegro and Kosovo.

Restricted infrastructure and non exiting standard operating procedures for priority storage locations, which still pose a significant risk of theft and illegal proliferation of SALW and their ammunition.

Security of eighteen (18) evidence rooms (three (3) in Montenegro, three (3) in Kosovo, three (3) in Bosnia and Herzegovina, four (4) in Serbia, three (3) in North Macedonia) as well as two (2) evidence rooms in the Republic of Moldova has been increased.
A total of 10,644 pieces of SALW, 4,998 parts and components of SALW and 50,000 cartridges were destroyed in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Republic of Moldova, Montenegro and Kosovo.

Two Regional Meetings of SALW Commissions and Two Regional meetings of SEEFEN

Two Regional Meetings of SALW Commissions took place during the reporting period. The 16th and 17th gathering representatives from SALW Commissions and relevant institutions in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Kosovo*, Serbia, and Ukraine and facilitated regional cooperation and support for evidence-based policy-making in SALW control.
The 18th and the 19th Regional Meeting of the South East Europe Firearms Experts Network (SEEFEN) were held in 2023 gathering senior police investigators, customs officials, prosecutors, ballistic experts and representatives of border police from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Kosovo, Serbia, and Ukraine to further deepen the exchange of operational information, know-how and best practices among key stakeholders
